read_by: Agent-drafted, from the cell's own tier table and decision log
input: Peak 3-second gust at 10 m (km/h); zero at or below 90, evaluated 108 to 252; for the canonical 5 MW proxy 90 to 108 returns zero and above 252 returns the maximum (both flagged)
not_covered: Rotor, nacelle, foundation, pad electrical, collection, GSU/substation, control building and SCADA, civil, fieldwork and transport (withheld, not zero)
out_of_scope: Storm surge, flood, scour, debris, rain ingress, lightning and fire
missing_mechanisms: Blade and other non-tower turbine failure modes (the curve is driven by tower damage states only)
next_version: Model v1.3 proposal: same curve, tower value re-based to 276 of 1,623 USD/kW (17.0% of a $162.3M physical TIV, $27.6M covered); not yet released

how_to_use.share_of: Tower value of the canonical 5 MW wind farm (0.16 of project TIV); source archetypes use the paper's own turbine/tower cost, which must not be multiplied by CWER values or site TIV

outputs.single_event: conditional: exact turbine archetype and source-assumption IDs; the canonical 5 MW route also needs the tower-proxy policy, asset-profile and value-basis IDs
outputs.scenario_dollars: conditional: only with an explicit tower value and exposure; covered loss capped at 0.16 of project TIV per event
outputs.yearly_loss: conditional: consumer-computed with validated hurricane frequency and intensity, 0.16 occurrence and annual caps, and disclosure that 0.84 is withheld

conditions: Saffir-Simpson category and NHC one-minute sustained wind are not accepted inputs
No averaging-period, height, terrain or hub-height bridge is included
A known operating state that differs from the source assumption withholds
No 5/3.3 capacity scaling and no rotor or nacelle value binding
Covered value is the tower only: 0.16 of canonical project TIV ($22.4M of $140M); the other 0.84 is withheld

method.summary: Published fitted expected-damage curves for generic steel turbine towers (Wind Energy, 2020) used as published; the 3.3 MW / 100 m curve stands in for the canonical 5 MW turbine, tower value only

key_sources: Probabilistic risk assessment on wind turbine towers subjected to cyclone-induced wind loads, Wind Energy 23(3), 528-546 (2020) (JAIMES_2020_TC_WIND_TURBINE / TCWW-S005)
Canonical wind-farm reference profile: 20 x 5 MW, $140M, tower share 0.16 (CONUS_WIND_FARM_REFERENCE_V1)
Owner scope correction authorizing the tower-only 0.16 binding (OWNER_SCOPE_CORRECTION_2026_08_14; governance, not evidence)
Hazard hurricane wind-farm EAL review that found the 0.63 value mismatch (HAZARD_HURRICANE_WIND_FARM_EAL_REVIEW_2026_08_14)
NREL, Cost of Wind Energy Review 2024 (TCWW-S010; comparison only)
judgment: No damage at or below 90 km/h is a source assumption, not measured
Damage-state cost ratios (1 MW 2/43/100%, 2.5 MW 4/48/100%, 3.3 MW 5/50/100%) are the source authors' assumptions
The source's own cost denominator is ambiguous and is kept quarantined
All non-tower parts are withheld, not zero

checks.name: Financial range check (Hazard repo): tower-value ceiling for wind-farm hurricane loss (shared lineage; no open industry loss figures found)

open_items: No separate rotor, blade, nacelle, foundation, electrical, substation, civil or support curves
Curve spread and damage-state probabilities not carried
No external financial-range validation of the annual results

rows.variants: source archetypes 1 MW / 44 m, 2.5 MW / 80 m, 3.3 MW / 100 m; canonical 5 MW / 100 m tower proxy (3.3 MW parameters unchanged)
rows.shape_basis: Published fitted curve shape and archetype parameters
rows.cost_basis: Damage-state cost ratios and the denominator quarantine are T4; the 0.16 tower share is owner-approved (no tier code)

notes.text: The 5 MW turbine uses the 3.3 MW curve unchanged; no capacity scaling
